speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Your questionnaire, very disappointing.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I answered every question Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You answered the multiple choice questions in a pattern. A B B A C. A B B A C.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Aw, you picked up on that huh?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: How could I not?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Come on! There's over 200 questions. And look at some of these things. Sheldon is to camaraderie, as the space shuttle is to blank?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hold on. I put some real work into that!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes, well it's better than what Wolowitz did. He drew a raccoon with what appears to be, a distended scrotum.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: It's kinda cute, until you get to the scrotum.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What hope do I have for establishing new relationships given that my current friends apparently cannot take a few hours out of their lives to help me?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, I'm not going to defend a big-balled raccoon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I don't see how you could.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What I'm trying to say is that, maybe you can't approach this as a purely intellectual exercise.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What do you mean!?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, remember when you tried to learn how to swim using the internet?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I did learn how to swim.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: On the floor.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The skills are transferrable. I just have no interest in going in the water.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Then why learn how to swim?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The ice caps are melting Leonard. In the future, swimming isn't going to be optional. But you do bring up an interesting point. I don't have to break new ground here, I'm sure much of the research already exists.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No! no, my point is, if you want to learn how to make friends, then just go out to a coffee shop or a museum. Meet people. Talk to them. Take an interest in their lives.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That's insane on the face of it. Come on. You're driving me to the mall. I'm going to acquire a book that summarizes the current theories in the field of friendmaking.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Where are we going?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why don't you just lie down on the floor and swim there?
